title: Design system
interaction: Use these tokens and patterns across tasks #1-#8. Financial figures and states are illustrative only.

title: Sign in
interaction: Continue -> verification challenge. No authenticated financial session before email-code verification.

title: Verify your email
interaction: Wrong/expired code -> inline error. Resend cooldown; codes single-use. Local Mailpit receives demo email.

title: Overview
interaction: Run checkup -> #7 workspace. Each metric opens its source account or calculation. Chat opens from the shared header.

title: Connected institutions
interaction: Category -> provider -> simulation login -> consent/account selection -> dashboard. Each connection can be synced or disconnected.

title: Link institution
interaction: Continue validates fictional institution credentials; wrong credentials stay on this screen. No call to the actual bank.

title: Consent & selection
interaction: Connect selected -> scoped connection. Unselected accounts are invisible to agents. Disconnect revokes future access.

title: Accounts
interaction: Select an account -> filtered transaction history. Manage -> connection flow. Liquid assets stay separate from retirement accounts.

title: Transactions
interaction: Filter and paginate on the server; row -> evidence drawer. Paired transfers are labeled, not counted as new income/spending.

title: Cash & bills
interaction: Date selection highlights responsible accounts and bills. Review adjustment -> plan comparison; no real transfers.

title: Subscriptions
interaction: Confirm recurrence/usage preferences first. Transaction history alone cannot prove a service is unused. Compare -> offer detail.

title: Offer comparison
interaction: Choose an option -> save proposed action with confirmation. This does not cancel or purchase anything; fixtures must stay labeled.

title: Debt & readiness
interaction: Run payoff scenario -> calculation evidence. Purchase readiness is planning, not a score-point prediction or loan approval.

title: Goals & plans
interaction: Create/edit goal -> target, deadline, priority and buffer. Compare plans -> explicit tradeoffs; acceptance is server-confirmed.

title: Plan comparison
interaction: Select -> accept dialog with expected plan version. Stale-version conflict -> refresh comparison. No automatic execution.

title: Assets
interaction: Asset snapshots contribute to net worth; investments and retirement accounts are not spendable cash by default.

title: Agent workspace
interaction: Run -> poll actual events. Expand findings -> source evidence. Completed/skipped/failed labels come from real run state, never timers.

title: Evidence drawer
interaction: Finding -> evidence references and calculation assumptions. Only records owned by this user and authorized connection are accessible.

title: Scenario lab
interaction: Preset/input -> deterministic stress results. Baseline stays unchanged. Show first failure date and tested horizon, not a guarantee.

title: Plan repair
interaction: Demo event -> new snapshot -> tool rerun -> proposed revision. Accept explicitly or retain previous accepted plan.

title: Settings
interaction: Logout invalidates session. Disconnect -> explicit confirmation and stale affected findings. Email/security edits are out of scope unless safely implemented.

title: Chat interface
interaction: Chat can read current scoped findings and request runs. It cannot authorize money movement or fabricate completion; richer chat features come later.

title: State patterns
interaction: Apply these states to each data screen. Preserve context and safe retry behavior; never display a fabricated successful result.

title: Mobile layouts
interaction: Mobile stacks cards; navigation opens as a drawer; chat is a separate drawer. Tables retain usable horizontal scroll. Reference screens are not runtime code.

title: Goal editor
interaction: Save -> validated goal endpoint. Cancel discards unsaved edits. Amount/date errors are inline; changes make dependent proposals stale.

title: Subscription preferences
interaction: Save preferences -> Deal Scout receives confirmed constraints. Unknown usage remains unknown; a planned change is not realized savings.

title: Accept plan
interaction: Accept uses expected_version and idempotency key. A stale response shows conflict and refresh; it never silently overwrites a newer version.

title: Disconnect institution
interaction: Disconnect -> revoke access and mark affected findings/plans stale. Cancellation preserves connection; no real bank account is closed.
